name: Blue Hawaiian
description: Rum, blue curaçao, pineapple, and cream of coconut—the turquoise colada Harry Yee built in Waikiki.
history: Harry Yee at the Hilton Hawaiian Village created the Blue Hawaiian in 1957 after a curaçao salesman asked for a drink that showed the liqueur’s color. It is the coconut colada cousin of the Blue Hawaii.
whyItWorks: Coconut fat and pineapple acid need rum underneath; blue curaçao supplies orange sweetness and the color the drink is named for.
steps: Shake rum, blue curaçao, pineapple, and cream of coconut hard with ice, or blend with crushed ice.
Garnish with pineapple and a cherry.
techniqueNotes: Toasted coconut rum can replace part of the white rum if you want extra coconut.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Clean rum under coconut and pineapple.
Optional extra coconut in place of some white rum.
